content: expo-file-system 57.0.7: default export is the NEW File/Directory/Paths API (import { File, Directory, Paths }). Legacy functions (writeAsStringAsync etc) THROW at runtime from main entry; must import from expo-file-system/legacy. File.write(string|Uint8Array, {append, encoding}), file.text()/textSync(), Paths.document/Paths.cache. Android File.contentUri for sharing. iOS config plugin opts enableFileSharing/supportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace.
